name: Kráľovský Chlmec (Slovakia)
description: Five equal horizontal stripes of red, green, white, green and red, ending at the fly in a swallowtail whose notch reaches one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature K-5/91.
